title: Spire and Choir
author: Astrid Blackwood
blurb: Astrid Sterling, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
